Get Verdict Report Quota Usage Details
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/sandbox/report/quota

The resource access quota for retrieving Sandbox Detail Reports is restricted to 3,000 requests per day, with a rate limit of 2/sec and 1,000/hour. Use GET /sandbox/report/quota to retrieve details regarding your organization's daily Sandbox API resource usage (i.e., used quota, unused quota).

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
startTime
int64

Start time

used
int64

Used daily quota

allowed
int64

Allowed daily quota

scale
string

Scale Unit (i.e., DAYS)

Possible values: [NANOSECONDS, MICROSECONDS, MILLISECONDS, SECONDS, MINUTES, HOURS, DAYS]

unused
int64

Unused daily quota

]
